newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 19.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Buddhist master Hsin Yun to visit the Vatican and meet with the Pope next month.
-- Government to allow senior high school students to study abroad.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Foreign senior high schools to be allowed to recruit local students studying in their countries.
-- China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping's condition said stable, but still serious.
LIBERTY TIMES - Chinese communists claim Deng Xiaoping's condition steady.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Stock markets in Taiwan, Hong Kong and China tumble over reports of Deng Xiaoping's deteriorating health.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government ad-hoc committee maps out countermeasures for possible financial confusion after Deng dies.
-- Hong Kong, Taiwan and China stock markets slump in response to Deng's reported ailing condition.
